sympathy.songTitle: Take These Chains from My Heart
sympathy.line: Give my heart just a word of sympathy
stanza: Give my heart just a word of sympathy
Be as fair to my heart as you can be
Then if you no longer care
For the love that's beating there
Take these chains from my heart and set me free

sympathy.line: I'm beggin' you for a little sympathy
stanza: Have pity, baby, just when I thought it was over
Now you got me runnin', runnin', runnin' for cover
I'm beggin' you for a little sympathy
And if you use me again, it'll be the end of me

sympathy.line: Cover me in rag and bone sympathy
stanza: Don't leave my hyper heart alone on the water
Cover me in rag and bone sympathy
'Cause I don't wanna get over you
I don't wanna get over you

sympathy.lineNext: Bent your branches down along the ground and cover me
